newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat takeover of Fidis completes Sept 30.
newsitem.headline: Fiat takeover of Fidis completes Sept 30.

text.p: Italian car group Fiat SpA said on Monday its takeover of financial services group Fidis would be completed on September 30.
It said in a statement Fidis shares would be no longer be quoted after that date.
Fiat's offer allows Fidis stockholders to exchange five of their shares for three Fiat ordianry shares, one preference share and one savings share, or alternatively for four Fiat ordinary shares.
Fiat said the swap must be carried out by September 30 otherwise only Fiat ordinary shares would be granted.

FIAT launched an offer for the 180.8 million shares, or 48.2 percent of Fidis shares it did not already own, in March. The offer closed in May with a take-up of 21.98 percent, or 10.6 percent, of company's capital.
